subject: FinHealth — Private VPC / On-Prem Discovery Recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finhealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: FinHealth — Private VPC / On-Prem Discovery Recap

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment. Let me know if I missed anything or mischaracterized your needs.

High-level pain / goals
- Need a private deployment option (VPC / customer-managed infra) for regulated PII/chat data.
- Primary concerns: network isolation, customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), audit logs / retention policy, and the option for an air-gapped on-prem deployment for certain regulated workflows.
- Goal: get a PoC running in a FinHealth VPC within Q3 to validate latency and auditability, then evaluate a pilot across two production services in Q4.

Current stack and constraints
- Primary cloud: AWS (us-east-1). Production services run in our managed VPCs.
- Identity: Okta SSO for employees.
- KMS: currently using AWS KMS (multi-account key policy).
- Network constraints: strict outbound firewall rules (only whitelisted IPs), internal proxy for egress, and limited public endpoint exposure.
- Compliance: SOC 2 in scope; some teams require encrypted persistence with customer-managed keys.

Success criteria for PoC
1) Private VPC deployment with no customer data leaving FinHealth account (traffic over VPC endpoints or peered network).
2) Redwood runtime configured to use FinHealth-managed KMS for model key encryption.
3) Audit logs (request-level) forwarded to FinHealth SIEM / CloudWatch with at least 90 days retention.
4) End-to-end latency under 250ms p95 for typical 512-token requests.

Security / deployment requirements discussed
- KMS integration: support for AWS KMS CMKs + ability to FIPS-validate HSM if needed.
- Network: allowlist of Redwood egress IPs OR peered VPC setup.
- Data handling: option to disable external caching and require local-only KV cache.
- Air-gap: multi-phase option — initial VPC deployment, then on-prem air-gapped appliance if required.

Next steps / owners
- Marissa (me): share SOC2 summary + security requirements template (attached) and proposed SOW draft.
- Dylan: schedule technical deep-dive with FinHealth infra + security (requesting 60–90 minutes).
- Aditya: prepare a short spec on KMS integration and required permissions for IAM role (we'll include an example policy).
- Samantha / FinHealth: confirm which teams will be in scope for the PoC and target dates for infra availability (est. mid-August?).

Attachments: finhealth-arch-diagram-stub.png, security-requirements-template.pdf

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinHealth — Private VPC / On-Prem Discovery Recap

Marissa — this is great, thanks for the detailed recap. A few clarifications / responses inline: 

- Timeline: mid-August for infra availability sounds right for an initial PoC. We can target Aug 16–20 for the tech deep-dive; will confirm internal calendars tomorrow.
- KMS: we use AWS KMS with a CMK per business unit. We will need Redwood to be able to reference our CMK and avoid exporting keys. If you can share the IAM role example and required KMS actions that will speed things up.
- Network: we prefer a peered VPC approach (VPC peering or Transit Gateway) to avoid managing large allowlists. We'll share the networking contacts.
- Audit logs: FinHealth requires request-level logs forwarded to our CloudWatch account and retained for 1 year for compliance — is that configurable?
- Air-gap: we don't expect to go fully air-gapped for the PoC, but we want the option evaluated for future phases.

Attachments: I uploaded our internal security checklist to the shared folder (I'll drop the link when I confirm with security).

Next steps from our side: I'll loop in infra and security, confirm tech deep-dive time windows, and send the list of initial PoC endpoints/team owners.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Security, FinHealth
samantha.lee@finhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:49:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FinHealth — Private VPC / On-Prem Discovery Recap

Dylan / Aditya — quick internal follow-up from Samantha's responses.

Action items:
- Dylan: coordinate with infra to propose 3 time slots for Aug 16–20 (60–90m) and draft agenda (networking, KMS, logging, SLOs). Owner: @dylan_brooks.
- Aditya: prepare IAM + KMS example policy and short doc describing how Redwood will reference CMKs without key export. Also include options for HSM/FIPS if they ask. Owner: @aditya_rao.
- Marissa: I'll prepare the SOW skeleton and attach SOC2 summary; please review before I send to Samantha.

I'll create the HubSpot deal and link the SOW draft: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/FH-2026-042

If either of you think we need legal or solutions engineering on the call, flag now — otherwise I'll keep the initial deep-dive to infra + security.

Thanks,
Marissa
